title: K6WP WallpaperConfig
description: Versioned on-disk configuration for the K6WP wallpaper engine. Stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%/K6WP/config.json. Version 0 (legacy) is missing the newer fields and is migrated to version 5 by the loader; version 1 migrates to version 5 with monitor_id forced to -1 (the v0/v1 id had no render effect); version 2 migrates with legacy fit_mode fill normalized to cover; version 3 migrates with battery_mode defaulted to cap24; version 4 migrates with cpu_affinity/gpu_adapter defaulted to auto. On migration (or corrupt input) the loader backs up the original bytes to <config>.bak and rewrites the file at the current version.

version.description: Schema version. 0 = legacy (missing fields are defaulted on load), 1 = monitor_id without render effect, 2 = monitor targeting (-1 = all screens), 3 = legacy fit_mode fill normalized to cover, 4 = battery_mode cap24|static, 5 = current (cpu_affinity auto|all + gpu_adapter auto|integrated|discrete).

video_path.description: Path to the wallpaper video file, UTF-8 encoded. May contain non-UTF8 bytes on disk; the loader reads the raw path.

fit_mode.description: How the video is fitted to the monitor. cover/fill = fullscreen fill (no black bars); fit = contain (letterbox); stretch = distort to fill; center = original size.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. Values outside 0.5-2.0 are rejected. RESERVED: validated and persisted but not yet applied by the renderer.

monitor_id.description: Target monitor id: -1 = all screens; >=0 = only that monitor.

crf.description: Compression CRF for the compressor. Values outside 16-28 are rejected.

resolution_w.description: Compress target width. 0 = use monitor native resolution.

resolution_h.description: Compress target height. 0 = use monitor native resolution.

fps_cap.description: Maximum playback/compress framerate. Values above 30 are rejected.

battery_saver.description: When true, the engine caps fps / pauses while on battery (DC power).

battery_mode.description: DC-power policy, consulted only when battery_saver is on and the box is on DC power. cap24 = cap fps to 24 (legacy behavior); static = pause slot decode via the power pause bit, holding the last frame, with no fps-cap change. Ignored on AC and when battery_saver is off.

cpu_affinity.description: Engine CPU affinity. auto = pin the engine to performance cores on hybrid (P/E) CPUs; all = use every logical processor.

gpu_adapter.description: GPU adapter preference for video decode/render on hybrid systems (mpv d3d11-adapter pin). auto = prefer the integrated GPU; integrated/discrete force that adapter when present.
